verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform that stores customer data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no user-configurable retention periods, data deletion, or account data purge capability. Its GDPR gap analysis and generated document packs (DPA, ROPA) help customers assess their own compliance, not control Sprinto's handling of their data, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.
